title: Repeated regular expression compilation
summary: Compiling equivalent regular expressions repeatedly in hot paths wastes CPU and allocations.
rationale: Regex construction inside loops, request handlers, or frequently called methods repeats work that can usually be reused.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large collections, high-traffic Rails actions, background jobs, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Move stable regular expressions to constants or memoized values, and avoid dynamic regex construction unless required.
remediation.tradeoffs: May require refactoring for readability, query shape, or framework conventions.
